notes.title: Patch Notes July
notes.notes:
Hello Fellow Harvesters!



As we introduce different ways of gaining APS we noticed the apple bonus is being overshadowed by the new mechanics. To keep the rarity of apples relevant and valuable we decided to add an additional bonus to having higher tier apples.



Different rarities of apples will provide aps bonus when equipped. 

mythic 5% 

legendary 4% 

epic 3% 

rare 2% 

uncommon 1% 



Additionally The number units are reworked for ease of readability - K, M and B representing thousands millions and billions. 



The window screen size will now remember your last setting upon opening the game.



Thank you for your ongoing support and input helping us grow.

Goodluck Harvesters!

notes.title: Big update!✨
notes.notes:
Update Note✨🍎🍏

Removed autoclicker - which has been replaced by abilities that can be bought with clickable apples.
Each upgrade of these abilities increases yield by a set amount per level per second.
Handpicker 0.1 APS initial cost 1000 cost multiplier 1.05
Fertilizer 0.5 APS initial cost 5000 cost multiplier 1.15
Honeybees 2 APS initial cost 15000 cost multiplier 1.25
Plantation 10 APS initial cost 50000 cost multiplier 1.35
Greenhouse 50 APS initial cost 150000 cost multiplier 1.45

Introduced offline idle income which is 10% of overall ingame APS.

Added random speech boxes that apples will say to the player as you play.
Having a better apple equipped increases rep with the apples which alter what it chooses to say to you.
Starting from outright disrespectful to honored of your presence. 

Added an idle animation for the apple on screen when player is not actively clicking.

The gift box price will increase sharply to match with the ever growing  yield
price increments increases every 12 purchases so plan your spending accordingly.

Happy harvesting yall🌿

notes.title: Gift box price increase update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
We noticed that spending wasn't quite keeping up with your apple yield, so we've made some adjustments to the gift box pricing system 🍎🎁

From now on, the box price will increase in steps of 100, 250, 500, and 1000, and it will cap at 100,000 until the next season update.

Happy harvesting, and enjoy the game! 🌿✨

notes.title: Leaderboard hotfix
notes.notes:
We've resolved the issue with retrieving leaderboard data from the Steam server! Leaderboards should now display correctly for all players.
🍏🍎✨

notes.title: Inventory Sync Update
notes.notes:
All steam items need 30 seconds to update and sync up with your account, hence, all the buttons related to steam items now have 30 second cooldown (including promo and the orchard bonus box).
Happy Harvest!
🍎🍏✨

notes.title: Big update! A talent tree has arrived🌳🍎🍏✨ and more..
notes.notes:
\Hello fellow harvesters,\

We're excited to bring you the first major update to the game. Here's what's new:

✅ A talent system

We've introduced 5 unique talents to boost your apple harvesting and improve your chances of opening more gift boxes.

Each talent has different unlock conditions.(such as level, cost, or required items)

👉 For detailed info, check out our Discord!

✅ A new perk button

A new perk button is now available! Activate it to gain a 20% critical hit chance for 15 seconds. Time it right for maximum yield!

✅ Leaderboard update

The leaderboard now takes 2 minutes to refresh by ensuring accurate data from Valve’s servers. Thanks for your patience!

notes.title: Double Harvest & Falling Leaves Update
notes.notes:
Struggling to snag a gift box as prices climb? Worry no more! 

In this update, you’ll find a brand-new Perk button in the bottom-left that doubles your apple yield for a short burst! Perfect for racing past those ever increasing box costs. 🍎😏

(condition: level 17 to unlock this perk!)

We’ve also given every click a little extra charm. Watch apple-tree leaves drift across the screen each time you harvest. 🌿

Update now, give it a try, and as always, feel free to reach out on our Discord if you spot any bugs. Happy harvesting!🍏🍎✨

notes.title: Hotfix: Crash After Purchasing Gift Boxes Fixed
notes.notes:
We’ve identified and resolved the issue that was causing a crash when purchasing gift boxes. The 30-second cooldown timer reset was the root cause, and it has now been corrected.

Thank you for your patience and understanding!

notes.title: Hotfix: Crash After 1-Hour Runtime
notes.notes:
Memory Leak / Orphan Nodes
Added explicit cleanup of spawned apple nodes and their child resources to eliminate orphaned Area2D, Sprite2D, AnimationPlayer, and AudioStreamPlayer2D instances.

Save-Thread Stability
Ensured the background save thread runs at LOW priority and joins before spawning new saves, preventing CPU contention.

Thanks for your patience!🧡🍎🍏
This should eliminate the silent crash around the 1 hour mark and keep your session running smoothly!
